name: Number Roll
description: A score counter that odometer-rolls to new values, pops on gain and floats a +N.
prompt: On each gain, ease the displayed value from what's on screen to the new total with a cubic ease-out over min(ROLL_MAX=1.1, ROLL_BASE=0.35 + ROLL_PER_DECADE=0.22*log10(remaining)) s so big gains roll faster per unit; pop the counter by POP_SCALE=0.28 settling in 0.22 s, bump TICK_POP=0.04 on each ones-digit tick, and show a +N floater that rises 22 px over 0.8 s, merging gains that arrive within FLOAT_MERGE=0.3 s.

key_numbers.name: ROLL_BASE
key_numbers.note: roll time for a gain of 1–9

key_numbers.name: ROLL_PER_DECADE
key_numbers.note: added per ×10 of the gain (so big gains cover far more units per second)

key_numbers.name: ROLL_MAX
key_numbers.note: cap on any roll

key_numbers.name: POP_SCALE
key_numbers.note: extra scale when a gain lands (0.28 = 128%)

key_numbers.name: POP_TIME
key_numbers.note: for the pop to settle

key_numbers.name: TICK_POP
key_numbers.note: extra scale each time the ones digit ticks over

key_numbers.name: TICK_TIME
key_numbers.note: for a tick bump to settle

key_numbers.name: FLOAT_RISE
key_numbers.note: a +N floater drifts up

key_numbers.name: FLOAT_TIME
key_numbers.note: a +N floater lives

key_numbers.name: FLOAT_MERGE
key_numbers.note: window in which new gains add into the latest floater instead of a new one

key_numbers.name: MIN_DIGITS
key_numbers.note: digit columns always shown (leading zeros dimmed)

name: Pickup Magnet
description: Gems wake when you get close, hop back, then spiral in and chime higher in fast chains.
prompt: When the player comes within MAGNET_RADIUS=64 px, give the gem a KICK_BACK=70 px/s hop away plus ORBIT_SPEED=90 px/s sideways, then pull it toward the player at ACCEL=1300 px/s² (MAX_SPEED=620 px/s), steering its velocity toward the player at STEER=6/s so the orbit spirals in; collect within 9 px with a 0.22 s pop ring and a sine chime at CHIME_BASE=660 Hz rising CHIME_STEP=1 semitone per pickup made within CHAIN_WINDOW=0.4 s of the last (capped at CHAIN_MAX=12 steps).

key_numbers.name: KICK_BACK

name: Button Juice
description: Menu buttons that lift on hover, squash on press and spring back with a ripple and click.
prompt: Give each button a damped spring (stiffness 520, damping 15) toward 1 while held and 0 when released, scale it by 1+0.06p wide and 1-0.14p tall, sink the face 4 px onto its base when pressed and lift it 3 px on hover; spawn a 0.45 s ripple from the press point clipped to the button, play a 0.05 s triangle click from 1400 Hz down an octave, and shake disabled buttons 5 px for 0.3 s instead.

name: Screen Transitions
description: Iris, diagonal wipe and pixel dissolve scene changes that cover, hold, then reveal.
prompt: Run every transition as cover (0.55 s) -> hold at full cover (0.28 s, swap scenes at its start) -> reveal (0.55 s); iris uses ease-in power 3 closing on a focal point and ease-out opening on the new one, the diagonal wipe uses ease-in-out power 2 with a 110 px slant and an 8 px accent edge, and the dissolve flips 20 px cells in random order linearly.

key_numbers.note: from first frame to full cover

name: Procedural SFX
description: Jump, coin, hit, explosion and laser synthesised live in WebAudio, no sound files.
prompt: Build each sound from layers (oscillator or lowpassed white noise) driven by one pitch curve f0*(f1/f0)^(t/dur) and one gain curve (4 ms linear attack, then (1-u)^2 decay) passed to setValueCurveAtTime: jump square 220->660 Hz in 0.22 s, coin square 988 Hz then 1319 Hz at 0.07 s over 0.32 s, hit 0.09 s noise plus a 160->45 Hz sine thump, explosion 1.1 s noise with the cutoff falling 2000->70 Hz, laser saw 1600->160 Hz in 0.17 s; create the AudioContext only inside a user gesture.

name: Dungeon Generator
description: Seeded rooms-and-corridors dungeons: random rooms, MST links, carved L-shaped halls.
prompt: With a seeded PRNG (mulberry32), try 80 random rooms of 4-10 cells on a 60x36 grid and keep up to 12 that clear the others by 2 cells, link their centres with a Prim minimum spanning tree plus extra edges under 18 cells at 15% chance for loops, then carve an L-shaped corridor per edge; the same seed always gives the same map.

name: Wave Spawner
